name: phase-aware-out-in-out-v2
purpose: static-contract repair of the rejected phase-aware-out-in-out-v1 implementation
static_review_clarification: Before any v2 implementation commit or environment execution, sequence review showed that current-frame steering substitution alone cannot preserve the inherited clear-straight pedal gates because they read prior emitted steering. V2 therefore uses a reset-synchronized frozen control shadow only as the longitudinal action reference. This does not change line geometry, thresholds or lateral output.

unchanged_from_v1: rows30/34/42/54, threshold1.5, entry/apex/exit predicates and two-frame exit/clear confirmation
outside/inside/outside fractions0.18/-0.10/0.18, steering gain0.016 and correction cap0.035
minimum geometric edge clearance7.0, obstacle/latch suppression, no map/seed/time/progress input
static_repairs_only: Keep a repeated same-direction entry active and reset clear counters on every non-clear transition.
Interpret0.035 as the lateral-reference correction relative to raw road steering. Because entry cancels the inherited0.05 inward preview, the explicit maximum candidate-control request delta is0.085.
Use geometric half-width=(right-left)/2 without an inclusive pixel count, then clip the desired offset to half-width minus7.0.

Do not write line requests into the inherited preview marker; when a line replaces an inherited preview, clear that frame's marker so post-slew equality cannot falsely arm it. Add no special line-to-obstacle zero-cross state. Obstacle transitions use the inherited sign/slew/limit rules from the actually emitted last steering action.

Maintain a reset-synchronized _LatchedClearStraightSustainController shadow on the same observations. Copy its gas/brake on every frame. While a current obstacle is detected or the inherited obstacle-side miss latch remains nonzero, copy its complete action and synchronize candidate _last_steer; clear the line phase. Outside that hazard fallback, shadow steering is never emitted. This preserves history-dependent longitudinal output and restores the known completion controller's natural obstacle trajectory instead of rate-limiting from a deliberately opposing entry line.

required_regressions: Three repeated identical entry frames all request the same outside line without alternating to the inward preview.
Clear-entry/apex-clear and other interrupted sequences require consecutive clear confirmations; ambiguous geometry clears stale direction immediately.
Entry correction relative to raw steering is<=0.035 and candidate-control request delta is<=0.085; apex/exit candidate-control deltas remain<=0.035.

At inherited steering values immediately below, equal to and above0.28, and on the following clear straight, candidate gas/brake and target state are exact to the reset-synchronized control while final lateral action follows the registered line and slew.

On the registered entry-to-opposing-obstacle sequence and mirrored counterpart, current-obstacle and all miss-latch actions are complete-action exact to the reset-synchronized natural control trajectory; candidate _last_steer is synchronized to the emitted fallback. This safety fallback may cross more than0.07 from the prior line action, just as the inherited preview-priority transition can bypass ordinary slew; all non-hazard line frames retain inherited clip/slew.

The inherited _previous_action_was_preview and _preview_requested fields are never armed by a non-preview line request, including the prior-steer equality boundary that emits exactly0.05 after the line replaced a preview.
The hazard fallback is inactive on every obstacle-free, latch-free phase frame and cannot change the phase targets, thresholds or clear-road steering.
The exact7.0 geometric clearance boundary passes without requesting less than7.0; nextafter-inside/outside and narrower/edge-breached spans suppress safely.
Mirrored entry/apex/exit, coherent opposite turns, continuing hairpins, missing rows, current obstacles, miss latch, invalid/lost/reset and randomized action bounds pass.
All prior affected tests and a temporary exact-file package smoke pass; bare-only routing and frozen file hashes are preserved.

abort: Any environment execution, training, submission, completion/lap-time claim or SOTA promotion occurs.
Any target fraction, threshold, gain, correction cap, phase definition, speed value, detector or obstacle parameter changes beyond the listed static repairs.

Any current-obstacle or miss-latch action differs from the reset-synchronized natural control shadow, the candidate _last_steer is not synchronized during fallback, any emitted gas/brake or target state differs from that shadow, or any preview marker is polluted.
Any predicted geometric clearance is below7.0 pixels or any stale phase survives ambiguous/missing/obstacle/lost-road input.
Any frozen model, official environment, DrQ artifact, user video or root submission.zip changes, or any relevant test fails.
compliance_blockers: SOTA.md, RESULTS.md, COMPETITION_INFO.md, RESTRICTIONs.md and report.pdf remain absent.
Only source, synthetic, unit and package validation is authorized; the candidate remains INCOMPARABLE.
